mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 6% percentage points signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain non-negative despite UNRATE crossing above 6%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong demand growth (GDPC1) combined with accommodative monetary policy (FEDFUNDS) creates a favorable environment for equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly positive when GDPC1 and FEDFUNDS are in favorable combination (p >0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 1.5% during a late-cycle expansion period signals accommodative monetary policy, boosting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly higher than baseline in late-cycle periods despite FEDFUNDS <1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong supply growth (INDPRO) paired with accommodative monetary policy (FEDFUNDS) reduces production costs and enhances corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive when INDPRO and FEDFUNDS are in favorable combination (p >0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An employment surge exceeding 131,000 in the labor market signals potential overheating, prompting investors to anticipate inflation and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain non-negative despite PAYEMS crossing above 131,000.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 5% percentage points reflects a robust labor market, fostering investor confidence and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive when UNRATE drops below 5% (p >0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 1% signals aggressive expansionary policy, accelerating equity market gains and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive despite FEDFUNDS <1% in expansionary periods (p >0.05).
